phases.title: Implement focus-on-open: capture previous focus element and move focus to close button when panel opens
Implement focus trap: intercept Tab/Shift+Tab keydown to cycle within panel focusable elements only
Implement Escape-to-close: attach document-level keydown listener that calls onClose when Escape is pressed
Implement focus restore: return focus to the captured previous element when the panel closes
Verify: run tests and confirm all pass with no build errors
phases.notes: All 22 tests passed (7 test files). Build succeeded with no TypeScript or Vite errors.
